metadata.title: Weyl chambers, asymptotic expansions, and blowup analysis of explicit Toda solutions
metadata.abstract: Blowup analysis is a central part of geometric analysis, and systems of PDEs such as Toda systems exhibit particularly rich blowup behavior. In [Nie25], the author constructed explicit families of radial Toda solutions whose blowup masses correspond to arbitrary elements of the Weyl group of the underlying Lie algebra. In this paper, we study these families within the framework of blowup analysis developed by C.-S. Lin and his coauthors. The key is an asymptotic analysis of the solution family that distinguishes Cartan elements in the interior of a Weyl chamber from those lying on its boundary faces. We prove a uniform upper bound for $u_i^{\lambda,H}(r)+2\log r$, so that the selection estimate holds with the center at the origin. We show that the successive bubbling scales for slow decay are determined by the intersections of the ray $H+tq_\mu$ with root hyperplanes. At each crossing, rescaling and the face asymptotics identify the limiting profiles as explicit solutions of the corresponding Levi-Toda subsystems. The masses of these successive bubbles, computed using [KLNW24], account for the entire blowup mass. Examples in type $A_2$ demonstrate this identification and exhibit both separated scalar bubbles and a simultaneous full-system bubble.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 对显式径向 Toda 解族进行爆破分析，以 Weyl 室及根超平面的组合结构描述连续冒泡尺度。
techniques: Weyl 室面上的渐近分析
analysis.breakthrough: 证明统一选择上界，并用射线穿过根超平面的交点确定慢衰减冒泡尺度；各泡质量之和覆盖全部爆破质量。
analysis.limitations: 研究针对既有显式径向解族，不等同于对任意非径向 Toda 爆破解完成分类。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
